title: Label recent Gmail receipts and invoices, archive them
brief: Goal: in the owner's Gmail, put receipts under the label Receipts and invoices under the label Finance/Invoices, and take both out of the inbox. Scope: inbox threads from the last 30 days only. Constraints: labels and archive only; never delete, never send, don't touch threads with a personal reply in them. Done: matching threads labelled and archived, each change listed with its undo; say what you couldn't do.

input.query: in:inbox newer_than:30d (receipt OR invoice OR "order confirmation")

input.summary: Labelled 4 receipts Receipts and archived them in Gmail. The 2 invoices (Figma, PG&E) are still in the inbox, unlabelled: there is no Finance/Invoices label and I can't create labels. Dana Lee's thread about splitting a dinner receipt has personal replies, so I left it.
